capabilityConnector.title: Notion connector — capability profile (read)
capabilityConnector.description: Connector used ONLY to read your capability profile database. This determines what the Actor searches for. See the README for the database template.
capabilityConnector.sectionDescription: Two separate connector fields, deliberately. The read field and the write field are held to different tool permissions by the Apify MCP proxy, so the read path physically cannot create pages. Select the same Notion connector in both fields.

pipelineConnector.title: Notion connector — contract pipeline (read + write)
pipelineConnector.description: Connector used to read existing pipeline rows for deduplication, then write new qualifying contracts back.

capabilityDatabaseId.title: Capability profile database ID
capabilityDatabaseId.description: The 32-character ID from your Notion capability profile database URL.

pipelineDatabaseId.title: Contract pipeline database ID
pipelineDatabaseId.description: The 32-character ID from your Notion contract pipeline database URL. Qualifying contracts are written here.

capabilityViewUrl.title: Capability view URL (fallback if SQL is over quota)
capabilityViewUrl.description: Open the capability profile database in Notion and copy the FULL browser URL — it must contain ?v=... The view ID cannot be derived from the database ID, so without this the database-view read path is unavailable. Only used when notion-query-data-sources is over your workspace quota.

pipelineViewUrl.title: Pipeline view URL (fallback if SQL is over quota)
pipelineViewUrl.description: Same thing for the contract pipeline database. Full URL including ?v=...

minimumScore.title: Minimum score to write back
minimumScore.description: Only contracts scoring at or above this are written to Notion. Everything scraped still lands in the dataset regardless.

dryRun.title: Dry run — score but do not write
dryRun.description: Runs the full read + scrape + score pipeline and logs exactly what would be written, without touching your Notion pipeline. Use this on your first run.

maxWritesPerRun.title: Max rows written per run
maxWritesPerRun.description: Safety cap. Notion rate-limits at roughly 3 requests/second, and an unbounded first run against a fresh pipeline can write hundreds of rows.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude Keywords — BLOCKLIST, not a search list
excludeKeywords.description: ⚠️ Anything you type here REMOVES results. This is not where you put what you are looking for. Your search terms live in the Notion capability profile as rows with Type = Keyword. Leave this empty unless you have something specific to filter out (e.g. 'janitorial', 'catering'). Exclusions can also be kept in Notion as rows with Type = ExcludeKeyword.
excludeKeywords.sectionDescription: These narrow results AFTER the Notion profile has decided what to search for. What the Actor looks FOR comes from your capability profile database, not from this form.

countries.title: Target Countries
countries.description: List of countries to monitor. Leave empty for all available (currently USA and UK).

minimumBudget.title: Minimum Budget (USD)
minimumBudget.description: Minimum estimated value converted to USD.

deadlineWithinDays.title: Deadline Within (Days)
deadlineWithinDays.description: Only include tenders expiring within this many days.

maxResultsPerSource.title: Max Results Per Source
maxResultsPerSource.description: Limit the number of results scraped per source.

includeNoDeadline.title: Include notices with no published deadline
includeNoDeadline.description: RFIs and Sources Sought notices often have no response date. They are early-stage signals — you hear about a requirement before the solicitation exists — so they are kept by default. Turn off to only see opportunities with a firm deadline.

includeExpired.title: Include Expired
includeExpired.description: Whether to include tenders that have already passed their deadline.

samApiKey.title: SAM.gov API Key
samApiKey.description: Optional — required only to include U.S. federal tenders from the official SAM.gov API. Free from sam.gov. Leave empty to run UK only.

samMaxRequestsPerRun.title: SAM.gov requests per run
samMaxRequestsPerRun.description: SAM.gov allows non-federal API keys only 10 requests PER DAY. Each profile signal costs one request, so this caps how many are spent per run. Classification codes are prioritised over keywords because they return far more results per request.

samCacheHours.title: SAM.gov cache lifetime (hours)
samCacheHours.description: Reuse SAM.gov responses this recent instead of spending a request. Set higher while developing so debugging runs don't burn the daily allowance; the tender feed changes slowly enough that 6 hours is safe in production.

notifyWebhook.title: Notification Webhook URL
notifyWebhook.description: Optional URL to POST a run summary to on completion.
